findings.evidence: M9 is the only nonconforming formula in the Closing customers row: adjacent periods use that period's opening customers plus new customers and churn (e.g., L9 = L5+L6+L7 and N9 = N5+N6+N7). M9 instead references L5, understating month-11 closing customers by 607 and cascading through all subsequent customer, revenue, and EBITDA periods. Recalculation with =M5+M6+M7 increases total EBITDA (P&L!AA15) from 15,415,480 to 16,164,947 and exit run-rate EBITDA from 10,053,982 to 10,743,897; at the 12.8x multiple, Valuation!B7 increases from 128,690,970 to 137,521,882.
